response.original_title: Sergiu Celibidache conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker: Bruckner Symphony No. 7
response.overview: For the first time after 37 years, Celibidache returned to the podium of the Berliner Philharmoniker for a reconciliatory concert. This was to be his final concert with the Berliner Philharmoniker before his death. Also available is the documentary "The Triumphant Return".
response.title: Sergiu Celibidache conducts the Berliner Philharmoniker: Bruckner Symphony No. 7
